user.title: Connect Utilities
user.description: Connect the local Utilities service. Provider accounts and credentials stay in its runtime configuration; this integration does not enroll or link accounts.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Utilities
reauth_confirm.description: Connect the local Utilities service. Provider accounts and credentials stay in its runtime configuration; this integration does not enroll or link accounts.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect Utilities app
hassio_confirm.description: Connect the discovered local Utilities app. This does not link or enroll any utility provider account.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The Utilities service rejected its credential.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the Utilities service. Check the URL, credential, and running app.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Utilities service can be connected.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered Utilities service could not be verified.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot verify the discovered Utilities service.

init.title: Match {app} versions
init.description: The app is on {app_version} and Home Assistant loaded {integration_version}. Home Assistant will verify a protected backup before applying {target_version}.

menu_options.restart: Back up and restart Home Assistant

progress.updating: Backing up and verifying the matching release.

abort.app_update_unavailable: The app does not offer a compatible managed update. Check Settings > Updates or update your standalone service.
abort.matching_release_unavailable: The update catalog does not offer a matching release yet. Refresh the updates and try again.
abort.entry_unavailable: The connection changed or is no longer loaded. Reopen the repair after the integration connects.
abort.managed_update_unavailable: Home Assistant could not find the update entities needed for this connection.
abort.update_in_progress: A backup or update is already running. Wait for it to finish before retrying.
abort.backup_not_configured: Select backup destinations and configure encryption in Settings > System > Backups.
abort.backup_failed: Home Assistant could not verify a complete, protected backup at every selected destination.
abort.update_failed: Home Assistant could not finish the update. Check Settings > Updates before retrying.
abort.verify_failed: Home Assistant could not verify the expected versions. Check the app and integration versions before retrying.
abort.restart_failed: Home Assistant could not restart. Check Settings > System and try again.
abort.restart_requested: Home Assistant is restarting. This repair clears when the integration reloads and verifies matching versions.

provider_credentials.title: Utility provider access is not configured
provider_credentials.description: Configure the approved provider credentials and explicit account/service bindings in the Utilities app. Public API documentation does not establish household eligibility. No accounts have been linked automatically.

provider_auth.title: Utility provider access needs attention
provider_auth.description: A provider rejected access. Review the provider connection in Utilities; do not assume an empty result means no bills or usage. No reauthentication or account-factor changes were attempted.

coverage_incomplete.title: Utility coverage is incomplete
coverage_incomplete.description: Some utility data is unavailable or only partially read. Check Utilities Settings and its coverage reasons before relying on bills, collections, or usage.

stale_data.title: Utility data is stale
stale_data.description: Utilities has no recent successful sync. Saved records remain historical data, not current provider state. Check provider coverage and request a sync when access is available.

energy_statistics.title: Utility Energy statistics are incomplete
energy_statistics.description: Electricity intervals could not be appended safely. Energy import requires fresh, complete coverage, correct Wh or kWh units, and continuous complete hours. Daily totals, missing intervals, and other units are not converted into invented hourly usage.
